items.title: Income multiplier detector
items.description: Community mechanism that estimates the current credits multiplier.
items.author: RWstudio community
items.code:
[core]
name: NotEk_multiplier_calc
maxHp: 0
price: 0
mass: 0
radius: 0
isUnselectable: 1
canNotBeDirectlyAttacked: 1
canNotBeDamaged: 1
showOnMinimap: 0
showOnMinimapToEnemies: 0
showInEditor: 0
hideScorchMark: 1
explodeOnDeath: 0
disableDeathOnZeroHp: 1
disableAllUnitCollisions: 1
onNewMapSpawn: mapCenter_asNeutral
generation_resources: credits=1,setFlag=24
generation_active: if self.hasFlag(id=23)and not self.hasFlag(id=24)
tags: NotEk_multiplier_calc
defineUnitMemory: float firstCreditsCheck, float creditDelta

[hiddenAction_calc1]
autoTriggerOnEvent: created
setUnitMemory: firstCreditsCheck=self.resource.credits
addResources: setFlag=23

[hiddenAction_calc2]
autoTrigger: if self.hasFlag(id=24)and not self.hasFlag(id=25)
setUnitMemory: creditDelta=self.resource.credits-memory.firstCreditsCheck
addResources: setFlag=25

# Example use:
# [hiddenAction_addIncome]
# autoTrigger: <condition>
# buildSpeed: 0s
# addResourcesWithLogic: credits=max(globalSearchForFirstUnit(withTag="NotEk_multiplier_calc",relation="any").readUnitMemory(name="creditDelta",type="float"),1)

order: 9
layer: shadow
alpha: 0.5

items.title: Autonomous dynamic unit-class tags
items.description: Adds AirUnit, LandUnit or UnderwaterUnit tags from unit height.
items.author: RWstudio community
items.code:
# Community example; reported as not tested in-game.
[hiddenAction_Settings]
@global airBL: AirBlacklisted, etc
@global landBL: LandBlacklisted, etc
@global underwaterBL: UnderwaterBlacklisted, etc

[hiddenAction_setTags_Air]
autoTrigger:"""
if self.height >= 10
and not self.tags(includes='AirUnit')
"""
temporarilyAddTags: AirUnit
temporarilyRemoveTags: LandUnit, UnderwaterUnit

[hiddenAction_setTags_Air_Blacklisted]
autoTrigger: if self.tags(includes='${airBL}')
temporarilyRemoveTags: AirUnit

[hiddenAction_setTags_Land]
autoTrigger:"""
if self.height >= 0
and self.height <= 10
and not self.tags(includes='LandUnit')
"""
temporarilyAddTags: LandUnit
temporarilyRemoveTags: AirUnit, UnderwaterUnit

[hiddenAction_setTags_Land_Blacklisted]
autoTrigger: if self.tags(includes='${landBL}')
temporarilyRemoveTags: LandUnit

[hiddenAction_setTags_Underwater]
autoTrigger:"""
if self.height <= 0
and not self.tags(includes='UnderwaterUnit')
"""
temporarilyAddTags: UnderwaterUnit
temporarilyRemoveTags: LandUnit, AirUnit

[hiddenAction_setTags_Underwater_Blacklisted]
autoTrigger: if self.tags(includes='${underwaterBL}')
temporarilyRemoveTags: UnderwaterUnit

items.title: Scrolling image decal
items.description: Scrolls a visible window through a vertically stacked source image.
items.author: RWstudio community
items.code:
[decal_credits]
layer: beforeUI
@define image_height: 560
@define scroll_speed: 30
@define visible_height: 50
frame_width: 352
imageStack: ROOT:UI\credits.png*${image_height}
frame_height: 1
yOffsetAbsolute: 0-((self.timeAlive*${scroll_speed}) % ${image_height})
xOffsetAbsolute: 500
stack_indexStart: min(${image_height},max(0,((self.timeAlive*${scroll_speed}) % ${image_height})-${visible_height}))
stack_indexCount: min(${visible_height},((self.timeAlive*${scroll_speed}) % ${image_height}))
stack_drawInReverseOrder: false
alwaysStartDirAtZero: true
stack_hOffset: -1
stack_frameOffset: 1
